about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a software developer based in Seville. I work at Surlabs, where my week splits between DevOps — Docker, Linux servers, CI/CD pipelines — and e-learning systems built on top of Moodle and ILIAS.
about.p2: Most of what I do sits at the seam between two systems: connecting a RAG pipeline to an LMS, wiring a release process across three environments, making a PHP module inside a long-lived open-source codebase behave predictably. That's the part I enjoy.
about.p3: Outside of that I build OpoFlash, an adaptive study platform that turns a student's own material into flashcards and schedules every review with an FSRS-5 spaced-repetition engine.

opoflash.tagline: Adaptive e-learning platform for Spanish civil-service exams
opoflash.description: OpoFlash turns a student's own study material into an adaptive review plan. Uploaded content is analysed by a custom RAG pipeline that generates flashcards and summaries, while a Python service based on FSRS-5 schedules every review against the forgetting curve. The services run independently behind Nginx, orchestrated with Docker Compose.
highlights: Custom RAG pipeline that reads student-uploaded material and generates contextualised flashcards and summaries
Spaced-repetition engine written in Python with FSRS-5, adapting intervals to each student's performance
Microservices split by responsibility, containerised with Docker Compose and served through Nginx
Designed, built and operated end to end — from the database schema to the deployment

surcontext.tagline: Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform for the ILIAS and Moodle LMS
surcontext.description: SURContext is Surlabs' RAG platform. It started inside ILIAS and now serves both LMS ecosystems: course material is ingested, chunked and embedded into a vector store, and an agent pipeline answers students and teachers from that material rather than from the model's own priors. I led the Moodle side end to end — the plugins that wire the LMS directly into the pipeline — and audited the system under load.
highlights: Agent pipeline built on LangChain and LangGraph, with model providers swappable between OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral and self-hosted Ollama
Document ingestion through Unstructured and PyMuPDF — PDF, Office formats and OCR'd scans — with embeddings served by sentence-transformers
Vector search over Milvus and Qdrant; conversation state and graph checkpoints persisted in MongoDB
FastAPI service with Celery and Redis handling the long-running ingestion and indexing jobs
Originated in ILIAS; I led the technical integration with Moodle end to end, then measured capacity and concurrency limits with Locust

checkeapp.description: Checkeapp checks claims against live web sources and returns a report where every statement traces back to where it came from. Built with TypeScript, Next.js and React on top of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline, reaching 95% accuracy in evaluation.
highlights: RAG pipeline pulling live web sources to produce verifiable, reference-backed reports
95% accuracy reached in evaluation
Asynchronous multi-step flow: question generation, source search, validation and report generation
Delivered under the ILENIA & ALIA public AI initiative with the University of the Basque Country

ilias-survey.tagline: Technical lead of a core module of the open-source LMS ILIAS
ilias-survey.description: Survey is one of the core modules of ILIAS, the open-source Learning Management System used by universities across Europe. I own its technical evolution: defining priorities, handling incidents, coordinating requirements with the institutions that use it, and shipping the changes.
highlights: Technical ownership of the module: roadmap, priorities and incident handling
Resolved 40% of the accumulated backlog after taking the module over

PHP codebase inside the ILIAS core, released through the team's CI/CD flow

ilias-plugins.tagline: Features, fixes and releases across the ILIAS plugin ecosystem
ilias-plugins.description: Ongoing work on custom and open-source plugins for ILIAS — STACK for STEM assessment, AIChat for LLM conversations inside the platform, LiveVoting for real-time participation — covering the full technical ticket lifecycle from the client report through to the release.
highlights: New features, improvements and incident fixes across custom and open-source ILIAS plugins
Full technical ticket lifecycle, from the client report through to the release
Release management via GitHub Actions with separate development, testing and production environments

qardrobe.tagline: EU Digital Product Passport compliance for fashion labels
qardrobe.description: A full-stack platform helping fashion labels comply with the EU's Digital Product Passport regulation. Garment lifecycle data is recorded immutably on the Polygon network, with Supabase handling authentication and application data.
highlights: Solidity smart contract deployed on Polygon, recording garment data immutably
React and TypeScript frontend with Supabase for authentication and data
Final project of the Higher Technical Degree in Web Application Development

color-ease.tagline: Colour palette generator with accessibility checks
color-ease.description: A tool for designers and developers to build colour palettes and check them against WCAG contrast requirements before they are used in production.
highlights: Real-time WCAG AA/AAA contrast checking
Palette generation based on colour-theory relationships
Conversion between HEX, RGB and HSL

todo-app.description: A task management app built on Firebase, with authentication and real-time synchronisation of tasks across devices.
highlights: Real-time sync through Cloud Firestore listeners
Email and password authentication
Responsive interface built with React and TypeScript

airport-manager.description: A Java desktop application for managing airport operations — flights, gates and schedules — with a Swing interface over a MySQL database through JDBC.
highlights: Full CRUD over a normalised relational schema
Swing desktop interface with JDBC data access
Coursework project focused on relational modelling

portfolio.description: Built with React 18, TypeScript and Vite, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS v4 design tokens and no component library. Light and dark themes, three languages, and animations that respect prefers-reduced-motion.
highlights: Token-based design system in Tailwind CSS v4, no component library
Full internationalisation in English, Spanish and German with i18next
Accessible by default: keyboard navigation, visible focus states and reduced-motion support
